FALL : B67 TV Tower Roleplay

Inspired by a story of two friends, one giant tower, and a very bad situation… now it’s your turn to survive!

🧗 Can you survive the climb… and make it back down?
⚠️ Watch out for unstable ladders and sudden falls.
💥 Real fall damage — the higher the fall, the harder it hurts.
🩸 Unrealistic blood FX toggle — turn unrealistic blood effects ON/OFF in game menu for your comfort.
🚁 Like the game and join our group to get your own helicopter!
